scaffold.message: Your budget stays on this device.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.updates: Your budget data stays on this device and is never sent anywhere. Each time the app starts (store and TestFlight versions), it checks for app updates with Expo, the update service; this is the only connection the app makes. Each check sends a random installation ID stored on this device, technical details of the installed version (platform, runtime version, update channel, update IDs) and, after a crash, the error message. Deleting the app removes the ID, but restoring a device backup can bring it back. Expo also sees your IP address. The app does not track you and has no ads or analytics.

encryptionUnavailable.title: This build cannot encrypt
encryptionUnavailable.body: Budget Lens keeps every budget on this device and refuses to save one unencrypted, so this build will not open yours. Install a build that includes SQLCipher.

recovery.title: We can’t open your budget
recovery.keyMissing: The encryption key for this budget is not on this device, or the file it belongs to is no longer here. The key never leaves the phone that created it, so restoring a phone backup or reinstalling the app can leave a budget unreadable.
recovery.migrationFailed: An update to your budget could not be finished. It was put back to the version from before the update.
recovery.keepsFile: Nothing was deleted: the budget file stays on this device, still encrypted.
recovery.confirmBody: The app begins with an empty budget and keeps the current file on this device. Restoring from your own backup arrives with the backup feature.
recovery.restoreFailed: An update to your budget could not be finished, and the version from before the update could not be put back either. An intact copy is still kept on this device, still encrypted, and nothing new was written over it.
recovery.stateUnrecognized: Some files of a budget are on this device in a state Budget Lens does not recognise, so it opened nothing and changed nothing. A new budget would need the key these files may still use, so no key was replaced.

storageUnreachable.title: Secure storage is unavailable
storageUnreachable.body: Budget Lens could not read this device’s secure storage, so it cannot open your budget. Nothing has been changed or deleted.

list.loadError: Couldn't load your items. Your data hasn't changed.
list.someInvalid: Some items couldn't be read and are hidden.
